decision.reasoning: Lease 1 confirms the notice: Chapel Street shop, landlord Elm City Properties, $2,400.00 monthly rent, next due 2026-09-02. That is 2 days from today (2026-08-31), so it matches "due in 2 days". Checking has $3,400.00. One other request is already pending: request 1, $840 for invoice 501 to Bulldog Print Co (ticket 101). Both together come to $3,240.00, which would leave $160.00. Cash covers both, so neither has to wait. Rent keeps the shop open, so it comes first. No earlier rent request or draft existed, so nothing is duplicated.
next_steps: Owner: approve request 2 (rent, $2,400.00) on the dashboard before 2026-09-02. Approving pays it automatically.
Owner: then decide request 1 (invoice 501, $840, ticket 101). If both are paid, $160.00 is left.
Owner: review draft 2 to Elm City Properties and send it if it reads right. It says the payment is being processed and gives no date.
After request 2 is paid, re-run ticket 102 to confirm the payment and mark it resolved.

Cash will be very tight ($160.00 left after both payments, and no money coming in). Accounting has noted an expected $8 restock purchase order for ticket 101 once invoice 501 is paid. Keep any other spending under $160.00.
